LanguageData.RatkinQL_JunkTree_Report: A junk-dealer with a creaky cart stopped by, looking for scrap and selling odd trinkets.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_Greeting: He leans on his wobbling cart, grinning. “{Interviewer_labelShort}! Got any scrap wood or metal lying around? Want to trade? Or just have a peek at my treasures?”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_OptBrowse: Browse the oddities on his cart.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_OptLeave: Say you have nothing to offer.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_Ware1: “Look at this—a pocket watch with a chipped face. Still ticks if you tap it. Probably belonged to a human merchant who lost a bet.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_Ware2: “This copper key? No idea what it opens. Could be a treasure chest, could be a privy door. That’s the fun of it.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_Ware3: “Half a book of old human recipes. Only the pages about mushroom stew survived. I’ll throw in a free guess at what the rest said.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_Farewell: He grabs his cart handles and creaks away down the road.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Junk_MsgSell: He hefts the timber, counts out the silver without hesitation, and piles the wood onto his cart. “Pleasure doing business!”
